Are you a recent or upcoming graduate interested in making an impact? Become part of a global and successful MedTech company located in the heart of Copenhagen.

About 3Shape

Things have moved fast at 3Shape ever since our founding in 2000. 3Shape specializes in developing 3D scanning and software technology solutions that enable dental and hearing professionals to treat more people more effectively, and with improved care. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is used all around the globe. A number which is skyrocketing and cementing our position as technology and industry leader, Danish growth comet and unicorn company. We are a truly international workplace with 50+ nationalities and more than 2200 employees globally. We are headquartered in Denmark in the center of vibrant Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

About the 3Shape 2-Year Graduate Program

3Shape’s two-year Graduate Program serves as a launchpad for a high-impact career. Graduates rotate through three different departments within the Commercial Track, with the possibility of an international assignment. This program gives talented and motivated young professionals the chance to acquire new knowledge, expand their skillset, and gain valuable expertise from the very beginning. Graduates gain unique insights into the core of our business and play an essential role in our strategy to develop future leaders and specialists at 3Shape.

Become Our Next Commercial Graduate

As a 3Shape Graduate, you will be a valued team member, tackle complex business challenges, and become part of an extensive network of professionals in a global organization. We offer a steep learning curve and expect high performance, but in return, you will have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

• Rotate through three departments (8 months each), such as Finance, Strategy, IT, People & Culture, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience and Engagement.

• Play an essential role in an international and innovative organization that is constantly evolving.

• Lead and contribute to real projects with measurable impact.

• Broaden your horizons by working as part of integrated teams across the globe and collaborating with people from diverse backgrounds.

• Join a well-established, social, and friendly community of current and former graduates.

• Receive ongoing feedback, coaching, and support from rotation managers, a mentor, and a buddy.

We Fuel Your Career With

• Comprehensive onboarding - including an offsite, teambuilding, and networking with the Senior Leadership Team.

• Regular meetings with your Graduate Manager focused on your development and well-being.

• Multiple training sessions (such as Case Challenge, People Module, Technical Training, etc.).

• A production visit to our site in Poland.

• Quarterly graduate-community activities.

What Makes a 3Shape Graduate?

You are about to complete or have just completed a master’s degree. You have achieved top academic results and are highly proficient in English. You are enthusiastic, focused, and eager to learn.

• An excellent collaborator with an empathetic approach and a global mindset.

• Highly versatile and adaptable.

• Thrives in an international environment.

• Motivated to take responsibility.

• Strong analytical thinker with solid problem-solving skills.

• Brings positive energy and is eager to apply knowledge and make an impact.

What 3Shape Offers

• A vibrant, international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues - over 20 nationalities represented in our Denmark-based office.

• An attractive healthcare package

• Daily breakfast and healthy lunches prepared by our private chefs.

• A good social work environment with many optional activities and clubs, from wine and beer tastings to board games, running, and paddle.

• Modern offices and R&D labs in downtown Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

Application Process

• Application deadline: 15/12/2026

• Graduate Program start date: 01/09/2027

• To apply, click "Apply Now" and attach your CV, answer two screening questions, and submit your academic records. Only complete applications will be considered.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis – please apply as soon as possible.

• After a successful application and initial video call screening, candidates will be invited to our headquarters in Copenhagen for an assessment center on Friday, January 29th.

• If you have questions about the position or process, contact people@3shape.com.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Are you passionate about designing cloud solutions that make a real difference?

Do you enjoy turning complex business challenges into innovative, scalable and commercially viable cloud solutions?

Are you motivated by working with customers, shaping technical strategies and collaborating with experts across an international organisation?

If so, we would love to hear from you!

At T-Systems, we help organisations navigate their digital transformation journeys through secure, innovative and future-ready cloud solutions. Our Portfolio Area Cloud plays a key role in driving this transformation, delivering solutions that create real business value for our customers.

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect/Designer to join our team in Copenhagen and help shape the next generation of cloud solutions for our national and international customers.

In this role you will play a key role in bridging customer needs, cloud technology and business value.

Working closely with our sales teams, architects, delivery specialists and portfolio experts, you will take ownership of designing end-to-end cloud solutions that are technically robust, commercially competitive and ready for successful delivery.

You will be a trusted technical partner throughout the customer engagement, helping translate complex requirements into practical, future-proof solutions.

What you'll be doing

• Design impactful cloud solutions: Develop end-to-end architectures across private, public, hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including cloud migration, modernisation, security and integration.

• Turn customer needs into solutions: Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, secure and commercially viable cloud designs.

• Shape winning proposals: Partner with sales and bid teams to develop compelling technical solutions, contribute to customer presentations and support complex IT outsourcing opportunities.

• Balance innovation and commercial value: Evaluate solution options, costs, risks and delivery requirements to achieve the right balance between performance, feasibility and business value.

• Collaborate across borders: Work with international teams, delivery units, security specialists and portfolio experts to ensure seamless solution development and handover.

• Stay ahead of the market: Bring industry knowledge, cloud expertise and an understanding of emerging technologies to help strengthen our solutions and competitive positioning.

• Drive continuous improvement: Contribute to architecture standards, solution frameworks and best practices across our Cloud Portfolio.

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness, a collaborative mindset and a genuine passion for solving customer challenges.

Ideally, you will bring:

• Proven experience in cloud solution design, solution architecture or technical presales, preferably within IT services, managed services or IT outsourcing.

• Great knowledge of private, public and hybrid cloud environments, cloud infrastructure and enterprise IT architectures.

• Experience designing complex end-to-end IT solutions and contributing to technical proposals or large-scale customer engagements.

• The ability to balance technical requirements, commercial considerations, delivery capabilities and customer expectations.

• Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.

• A proactive, structured and customer-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership and work independently.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling occasionally when required.

Why join T-Systems?

At T-Systems, you will have the opportunity to work on complex and meaningful cloud transformation projects, collaborate with experienced specialists across our international organisation and help shape solutions for leading customers.

You will be part of a business where technical expertise, collaboration and fresh thinking are valued, and where your ideas can contribute to how we develop our cloud services.

We believe that our culture is shaped by the everyday actions of our people. Each of us has the opportunity to make a positive impact on our colleagues, our customers and our business.

Because at T-Systems, our people make the difference. #peoplemakethedifference

If you are excited about combining cloud technology, customer engagement and solution innovation, we would love to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Would you like to help strengthen climate adaptation across the Nordic region? Join Tryg’s Climate Excellence team as a student assistant and help turn data into insights that support better decisions.

About the job | A student job that creates value

You will join the newly established Climate Excellence team, part of Tryg’s Insurance Technical Group Function. The function drives technical excellence and data-driven decision-making across the Nordic business to support Tryg’s long-term competitiveness.

The goal of Climate Excellence is to help Tryg better understand and respond to climate risks, supporting smarter decisions for both the business and our customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Collecting, structuring, and visualizing data and information for analysis

• Exploring trends across multiple data sources and translating findings into practical recommendations

• Preparing presentations and decision-support material for colleagues and management

• Supporting projects and initiatives related to climate adaptation and resilience

You will gain insight into how data, insurance, climate adaptation, and business strategy come together in practice while developing analytical and communication skills in a Nordic organization.

The role is based in Ballerup and involves collaboration with colleagues in Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We occasionally meet as a Nordic team in Bergen or Stockholm, approximately once a month. Participation is optional, and online attendance is always possible.

About you | Curious, collaborative, and interested in working with data

You are currently enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, such as business, economics, engineering, technology, mathematics, data science, climate studies, or a related field. Ideally, you have at least two years remaining in your studies.

You enjoy working with both quantitative and qualitative information, identifying patterns, and presenting insights in a clear and structured way. You are curious about developments in society and motivated by learning through varied tasks and collaborations.

The following skills will help you succeed in the role:

• Experience using Excel to structure and analyze data

• Experience using PowerPoint to communicate insights and recommendations

• An interest in data analysis and tools such as Python

• Strong written and spoken English skills

You do not need to meet every criterion to apply. We are primarily looking for someone with curiosity, motivation, and the willingness to learn. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

The position is approximately 15 hours per week, and your working hours will be planned flexibly around your studies and exam periods.

About us | Personal and professional development

Climate Excellence works across Tryg’s Nordic business to develop and standardize climate-related initiatives and strengthen climate knowledge throughout the organization.

You will join a small Nordic team with backgrounds in climate, analytics, insurance, and business development. We collaborate closely across countries and functions and believe the best solutions are created through teamwork, knowledge sharing, and diverse perspectives.

We offer:

• Meaningful tasks with real business impact

• A supportive environment with responsibility and guidance

• Flexible working arrangements that accommodate your studies

• Opportunities for personal and professional development

• A strong professional and social community

We look forward to hearing from you

We welcome applications from students of all backgrounds and value different perspectives. We focus on skills, motivation, and potential, and strive to provide an inclusive recruitment process and working environment. We encourage you not to attach a photo to your CV.

We recommend sending the application as soon as possible as we are holding interviews continuously.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Analyst Oliver Christensen at: oliver.c@tryg.dk

Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

_atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

__With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

__Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

__We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

__By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

_**Leadership Development Partner at atNorth

**Most leadership roles let you improve a program. This one lets you shape how a fast-growing Nordic company develops its leaders.

atNorth is scaling quickly across five countries, and our leaders are building something new while they lead it. They need development that fits their real situations: a first-time manager taking over a team at a new site, or a senior leader handling growth, change and complexity at the same time. As our Leadership Development Partner, you'll be the person they turn to.

You'll design and deliver our leadership programs from first-time people managers to senior leaders. You'll coach leaders one to one, facilitate cohorts and forums, and connect leaders across borders so they learn from each other. You'll also help shape how we assess, promote and plan succession for our leaders, so your work will influence who leads atNorth in the future.

You'll work closely with the Manager of Leadership, Learning & Development, our P&C Managers (Business Partners) and the Learning & Development team. You'll have real ownership: you choose facilitators and coaches, adjust programs based on what the data shows, and recommend leader promotions. You also co-own the development, design and maintenance of leadership and people concepts.

If you're an experienced leadership developer who wants to see the results of your work, this is the role for you.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Lead and deliver the atNorth Leadership Development program for all leaders, along with customised and on-demand leadership training modules (incl. training for employee satisfaction and wellbeing)

• Design and run onboarding cohorts for first-time people managers and help them build a strong foundation from day one

• Provide 1:1 coaching for selected leaders

• Co-own the development, design and maintenance of leadership and people concepts.

• Co-own and facilitate the atNorth leaders’ forums and Leadership Hub (self service) from content development, agenda setting to follow-up actions

• Use participant feedback, outcome data and assessment tools (such as 360 feedback) to continuously improve our programs

**Your profile:

**

• You have at least +7 years of proven track record/experience from a similar role

• You have a relevant Masters Degree in organizational psychology, HR, education or a related field, or equivalent experience

• You have solid experience designing and facilitating leadership development programs, ideally in a multi-country organization, in person and online

• You're a skilled coach, comfortable with both 1:1 leadership coaching and group coaching; an ICF (ACC/PCC) or equivalent certification is a strong plus

• You have hands-on experience with leadership assessment tools such as 360 feedback, Insights Discovery / DISC or Hogan

• You build trust quickly with leaders at every level, from new managers to senior executives, across cultures and countries

• You combine strong business acumen with a good understanding of core People processes such as succession, promotion and performance dialogues

• You communicate clearly and convincingly in speech, in writing and visually, and you can turn complex ideas into simple concepts and processes

• You manage multiple cohorts and programs at once, and you speak and write fluent in English

**About The AtNorth Culture

**_We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

__We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

__We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

__At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

_**Application or Questions?

**Please note that the role is based in even Denmark (Copenhagen area), Finland (Espoo) or Sweden (Stockholm area) and travelling across the Nordic countries will be required as a part of the role.

Please submit your application no later than 31:st October, please note - ongoing selection reviews will be conducted and the position might be closed before end date.

_Also - please note - atNorth will at this point not have the possibility to support any work permits or visas for this role.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead is a key role within Genmab’s Transformation Office (TO). The Senior Director will be the central orchestrator for operational and strategic initiatives, including initiative intake, prioritization, governance, reporting, and portfolio performance management. You will ensure that Genmab's most strategic initiatives are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value.
